statements.statement: The service was mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229)
The denial reason code was CO-197
The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient had a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture the arrhythmic burden and correlate rhythm disturbances with neurological symptoms to guide anticoagulation and rate control strategies
